section_sequence.what_it_does: A thin black nav (wordmark, links with superscript counts, 'Online (4)' status, Contact Us) over a full-viewport real-time 3D render of the studio basement, with a floating HUMAN/MACHINE toggle pinned at the bottom center.
A large grotesk headline in three lines on the left with a small three-line paragraph under it, on black.
A 6-column grid of client logos in thin-bordered cells, six rows deep.

A pinned 'Featured Projects' header over rows that pair a large project image on the left with a short description and the project name at the right; rows cycle through Vercel Ship, Daylight, KidSuper and Shop MrBeast.
A large four-line statement headline over four columns (Websites & Features, Visual Branding, IRL Experience, Marketing Execution), each with a paragraph and small tag chips.
A dark panel with 'Let's make an impact together.' and the email address set at headline size.
A full-width condensed 'BSMNT.26' wordmark, a newsletter field on the left, a large stacked nav list, and social/legal lines.

motion.observed: Loads blank, then black, then shows the room as a white wireframe, then pixel blocks scatter and resolve into the fully lit render (intro t=0 still shows scattered squares); settled by 0.7s.
The TV-wall screens change content between intro frames while the camera and scene hold still. The seated figure on the stairs differs between captures (inferred: it varies per load).
The header stays pinned while project rows move up beneath it; in desktop-full this area is mostly blank black space.
'BSMNT.26' first appears clipped at the bottom edge, then is fully visible at the top of the final frames.
The pill stays fixed at bottom center over every section on desktop and mobile.

reduced_motion: No visible difference: the lit 3D room renders the same as the settled intro (the nav 'Online' count reads 6 here). running_animations is 38 in both runs, and the canvases (2) are still present.
mobile: The nav becomes the wordmark, a dotted status indicator and 'Menu' plus a hamburger. The 3D hero is cropped to a portrait slice with the headline directly below it, and the HUMAN/MACHINE pill floats over content throughout. The logo grid drops to 3 columns, with some cells empty mid-capture. Projects become stacked image-then-caption cards. Capabilities go to 2×2. The footer shortens the wordmark to 'BSMNT' and sets the nav list in very large type.
adaptable_ideas: Stage the hero reveal in three passes (black → wireframe → pixel-dissolve → lit), so a heavy scene feels built in front of the viewer rather than loading.
Set contact details (the email address) at headline size as the page's second-to-last beat, not in footer small print.
End with a full-bleed condensed wordmark sized edge to edge as the footer masthead.
Use superscript counts on nav items (Showcase 26, Blog 29) to signal depth without extra UI.
capture_issues: In desktop-full the 3D hero canvas renders as empty black, and there is a large black gap before Featured Projects (the pinned section shows only one project).
mobile-full paints the fixed nav over the Contact section.
The first mp4 frames are blank white/black while the WebGL scene initializes.
not_verified: Hover and pointer interaction with the 3D scene
Whether empty mobile logo cells are a rotation mid-state
